answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller to lock a bond for 30 days before accepting jobs, with the bond forfeited if a signed delivery receipt proves double-selling an exclusive asset. Whether agents sell comet images, canyon maps, or opal appraisals, each extra identity needs its own bond. An attacker running 1,000 fake sellers must immobilize 1,000 bonds and risks losing each one used to cheat; creating new names cannot recover forfeited funds.
